summary: Iteration 29 - Testing Loading States, Empty States, and PWA Enhancements. All backend tests passed (11/11). Frontend tests verified Finance Dashboard, Coordinator Dashboard, Marketing Dashboard, and PWA functionality. Loading skeletons and empty states are properly implemented.
critical_code_review_comments: Loading states and empty states are properly implemented with data-testid attributes
PWA service worker v2 is registered and active with proper caching strategies
Skeleton components (TableSkeleton, CardSkeleton, StatsSkeleton, PageSkeleton) are well-structured with data-testid
EmptyState component is reusable with icon, title, description, and optional action button
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 improvements (Database Indexing, PWA Enhancements, Loading/Empty States) are implemented and working. Finance Dashboard shows dashboard cards with RM currency. Invoices tab shows proper empty state with FileText icon. Coordinator Dashboard shows empty state with Calendar icon when no sessions assigned. Marketing Dashboard loads with stats and quotations data. PWA service worker is active with cache-first for static assets and stale-while-revalidate for API data. Admin user cannot access supervisor/trainer dashboards (redirects to calendar) - this is expected role-based access control.
